summary: The report matches the evidence: all claimed structure, checks and page contents check out, and it openly lists its unverified items. Two small wording overreaches don't change the picture: 'every rich-text block has several paragraphs' (the front-page intro is one paragraph) and 'every photo has a caption crediting the photographer' (post hero images have no credit).

claims.claim: Front page and both posts return 200 at https://localhost:44317; every block renders with no 'Could not render component' fallback
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: /, /mcp-is-the-usb-c-of-ai/ and /why-mcp-makes-your-cms-talk-back/ all return 200 with an empty renderErrors list

claims.claim: Three blocks in the Blocks folder: Rich Text, Image (image, caption), Quote (quote, attribution)
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' lists richTextBlock, imageBlock (image, caption) and quoteBlock (quote, attribution) in Blocks; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes

claims.claim: One Block Grid data type 'Blog Body Grid' allowing the three blocks
claims.evidence: grade.md: the 'Blog Body Grid' data type allows the 3 blocks; uSync DataTypes/BlogBodyGrid.config was added

claims.claim: Page types in Pages with own templates on a shared layout; Front Page (title, blocks), Post (title, publishDate, excerpt, listingImage, blocks)
claims.evidence: grade.md lists the same properties and templates (layout, blogFrontPage, blogPost); check.json reports 3 templates

claims.claim: Front page allowed under Site Root, post under front page
Imported 5 photos from unsplash/ into a 'Blog' media folder
claims.evidence: check.json content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos: 5 of 5 are the provided photos; content.mediaInFolders passes; uSync Media/blog.config was added

claims.claim: Front page: intro paragraph, photo, then posts newest first
claims.evidence: pages/index.html has a richTextBlock and an imageBlock; the frontpage screenshot shows the 6 Oct post before the 22 Sep post

claims.claim: Post block orders: text, image, text, quote, text / text, quote, text, image, text
claims.evidence: The data-content-element-type-alias order in pages/mcp_is_the_usb_c_of_ai.html and pages/why_mcp_makes_your_cms_talk_back.html matches exactly

claims.claim: Every rich-text block has several paragraphs
claims.evidence:
pages/index.html line 34: the front-page rich-text block has a single

. The report itself calls it 'an intro paragraph'

claims.claim: Every photo has a caption crediting the photographer
claims.evidence: This is true for the image blocks (figcaptions with 'Photo: … on Unsplash'). But the post hero listingImage has no caption or credit (grade.md minor issue; the blogpost screenshot shows the hero with no caption)

claims.claim: All three pages published; front page has domain /
Adapters per block without markup, ViewComponents with Default.cshtml, plain models in Models/Blocks, GetBlockGridHtmlAsync, GetCropUrl
claims.evidence: check.json passes code.adapterPerBlock, adaptersHaveNoMarkup, viewComponentPerBlock, pagesUseBlockGridHelper, noHandWrittenImageQueries and noUnsignedResizeUrls

claims.claim: npm build succeeded, compiled CSS present
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt and site.stylesheetsLoad (200); both screenshots render fully styled

claims.claim: Stylesheet and front page images returned 200; in-post images not fetched individually
claims.evidence: check.json: 7/7 images load, all local /media URLs with hmac. The report openly says the in-post images were not checked individually

claims.claim: Issues: 'Publish cancelled' on descendant publish, empty publishedUrls, uSync export unchecked
claims.evidence: These are process observations that the artifacts can't confirm. grade.md says they match the transcript. uSync config files do exist in check.json changes
